decisions.statement: The tree is composed at the moment of asking rather than read from a store.
An initiative is keyed by the slug the initiative declares rather than by the file name.
An initiative whose parent is not there is drawn as a root and stays in the tree.
An initiative whose parent chain closes into a cycle is drawn as a root.
The intents an initiative has are drawn beneath that initiative.
An intent keeps the place its initiative states rather than being sorted.
The intents come ahead of the initiatives beneath.
An intent is keyed by its initiative's slug and its place in that list.
An intent opens the page of the initiative with that intent.
An intent has its working memory as its note.
A row says whether the row is an initiative or an intent.
The rows are counted by the kind each row is rather than all together.
Each word names the thing to print.
A call naming no word prints the tree.
A call naming two words is refused.
A word said twice names one thing rather than two things.
The colors are read from the seat pages alone.
Reading the colors opens no initiative page.
An intent has no color.
An initiative no seat sits on has no color.
An intent leads nowhere.
A tree with no initiative is refused rather than printed as nothing.
Every answer here is built by a function rather than written out as a value.
A tree with no initiative is a fault of the data.
A run writes nothing.

definition: the command drawing each initiative under the one above it, and the intents it has
